description: This source file defines the interface NotesAPI_0_2 for interacting with the Notes API version 0.2. It specifies methods for retrieving, creating, editing, deleting, and updating notes through HTTP requests, utilizing Retrofit annotations for REST API communication.

classes.name: NotesAPI_0_2
classes.description: Interface providing methods to interact with Nextcloud Notes API v0.2, including operations for fetching, creating, editing, deleting, and updating notes via HTTP requests.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes modified after a specific timestamp, optionally using ETag for cache validation.

methods.name: getNotesIDs
methods.description: Fetches metadata of notes excluding content and other detailed fields, likely for listing or synchronization purposes.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note API object supplied as body in the HTTP POST request.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its remote ID.

methods.name: editNote
methods.description: Edits an existing note identified by remote ID with the provided note data.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note identified by its remote ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates a note identified by its ID with the provided note data.
